import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Creating the DataFrame from the provided data
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige'] * 5,
    'SexLang': ['männlich'] * 5,
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Setting the aesthetics for the plot
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='KreisLang', hue='SexLang', palette='Set2')

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Anzahl der Hunde nach Kreis und Geschlecht', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Kreis', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Anzahl der Hunde', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Geschlecht')

# Save the plot as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
